requirements.text: RRULEs (FREQ, INTERVAL, COUNT, UNTIL, BYDAY, BYMONTHDAY, BYMONTH) expand to the correct occurrences
Invalid or unsupported rules are rejected, and expansion is bounded
Occurrences keep their wall-clock time in the event's time zone across DST changes
EXDATE/RDATE and single-occurrence overrides are applied
Occurrences can be listed for a date window without expanding the whole series
Editing "this and following" splits the series without changing past occurrences
